title: Better light on heroes and monsters
changes: Heroes and monsters are lit more like the rest of the world: clear lit and shadow sides from the same upper-left light as the village props.
Arms, hoods, shields and horns now cast real shade onto the body, and folds stay dark without greying the whole figure.
Shading is made of clean pixel clusters instead of speckled noise, and dark creatures keep a faint edge of light so they stay readable at night.
